 06/Dated: 20 April, 2023
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicants who are in custody since 03.06.2022 have approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Meral P.S. Case No.112 of 2022 corresponding to POCSO No.61 of 2022, registered for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the POCSO Act and under Section 3(2)V of the S.C. & S.T. (PoA) Act, pending in the court of learned Special Judge POCSO Act, Garhwa.
3.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
4. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicants and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.

It has been submitted that the girl has not alleged rape under her Azad Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135081347/
1 statement made under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.

entities.text: her Azad Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. From perusal of the records, it appears that the examination of witnesses is going on.
7. Considering the material available on record and the stage of the trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.
8. However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same within six months from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
